description: This Java class defines an Akka HTTP route handler for the '/status' endpoint, providing sub-routes for overall status, health, and cluster information within the Eclipse Ditto Gateway service.

classes.name: OverallStatusRoute
classes.description: A final class that builds Akka HTTP routes for the '/status' endpoint, including sub-routes for overall status, health, and cluster information.

methods.name: buildOverallStatusRoute
methods.description: Constructs and returns the Akka HTTP Route for '/status' with sub-routes for status, health, and cluster information.

methods.name: createOverallStatusResponse
methods.description: Creates a CompletionStage<HttpResponse> for the overall status retrieved from the StatusAndHealthProvider.

methods.name: createOverallHealthResponse
methods.description: Creates a CompletionStage<HttpResponse> for the overall health, with HTTP status depending on health status.
